**Resubmitted: deviation (RENEWAL), fallback cure — validated ok:true and submitted.**

Why the earlier attempts kept tripping the deterministic window check: the check reads the *newly inserted* operative text and needs the window expressed as a number of days tied to the notice itself. In-place numeral swaps left "days written notice to the other" in the retained words, so every insertion contained either the bare number ("sixty (60)") or a number with no notice language ("at least 60 days in advance"). Restructuring the edit was the only way to put the whole phrase into new text:

- Section 4.1 now reads: "...unless terminated by either Party hereto upon **the prior notice specified below**. Such notice shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated (the 'Termination Date')."
- New sentence in Section 4.1: "**Either Party may so terminate this Agreement upon sixty (60) days' prior written notice to the other.**"

- **Coverage:** notice-window element addressed by operations 1–2 (house-style "sixty (60) days' prior written notice"); price-uplift element already met/untriggered by the fixed 30% Net Sales share in Section 3.1.
- **Intent check:** the 90-day figure is gone, so no contradictory retained period; "the prior notice specified below" resolves to the inserted sentence, which sits inside Section 4.1 before the 4.2 heading; "Such notice" and the "Termination Date" definition still operate, and the mutual either-Party exit right, one-year renewal term and anniversary mechanic are untouched.
- **Not drafted, raised for negotiation only:** preferred-level items (mutual-agreement renewal gate, 30-day opt-out, 60-day HDI reminder, CPI/3% cap) and the one-way/split notice-period point.
